sections.name: File setup (part 1)
sections.title: Find and unzip the pack
sections.what: Checks for persona-pack.zip at the root and stops with an error if it is missing. Otherwise unzips it and works out where its content begins.
sections.why: Likely reason: the zip may have a wrapper folder, so the job looks for the persona folder inside it.
sections.watch_out: If the zip has no persona folder, the job falls back to copying from the whole unzipped folder.

sections.name: File setup (part 2)
sections.title: Copy files and commit
sections.what: Copies the persona, config and applications files into the project, prints a list of what landed, then commits and pushes.
sections.why: Likely reason: puts each part of the pack in the folder the rest of the app expects.
sections.watch_out: Copy errors are suppressed, so a missing folder does not stop the job. Check the final list.

summary: Manual job that unzips persona-pack.zip from the repository root, copies its persona, config and applications files into place, then commits and pushes.
purpose: Brings the owner's persona files into the repository.
why: Likely reason: the personal files arrive as one zip, and this job moves them into the folders the app expects.
how: 1. Runs only when started by hand. 2. Checks for persona-pack.zip at the root and stops with an error if it is missing. 3. Unzips it and finds where the content starts. 4. Copies the persona, config and applications files. 5. Lists what was copied. 6. Commits and pushes.
outputs: Files in the persona, config and applications folders, and a pushed commit.
risks: Copy errors are hidden, so a failed copy can pass silently. The personal files go into the git history, which is hard to remove later. Everything staged is committed, not only these files.
debug: If the job stops at the first step, the zip is missing from the root or has a different name. If the final list shows empty folders, check the zip's internal layout.
